family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: determine the current trustee at the bank-meeting cut-off despite signed papers and later administration. The blind review verifies that the registered release effects simultaneous retirement and replacement, while an affirmative hold preserves the incumbent (family_a/review/blind-review.md). The necessity review verifies the two-Source instrument-and-disposition routes and rejects a proposed shorter route (family_a/review/necessity.md). A0/A1 preserve the key and context with Source bytes fixed and only order changed (family_a/review/matched-sources.json). The bank and administrative papers carry supported kinship and non-operative details. Recency and frequency favor the incumbent, while draft promotion favors the successor; a two-person office and explanatory wording limit what success demonstrates.
family_assessments.overlap: Joint proof overlaps with B and C. D also concerns an operative instrument, but D varies its reach while A varies whether the handover took effect. Retain A as the release/hold and local order control.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: identify the speaker of a dated parentage statement without guessing from the contact list. A separately maintained attendance record binds the native statement to one speaker only when the name field is complete; with the partial field, two speakers remain compatible and the ordinary parent edge survives (family_b/review/outputs/comparison.json; family_b/review/agreement.json). The forward and export share an informant, and the forward-only readings do not fix the speaker (family_b/review/mask-results.json). Removing a required identity or statement fact defeats the focal edge without disturbing ordinary kinship (family_b/review/proof-deletions.json). The clerk's sighting supplies that ordinary evidence independently. A completeness check followed by first-contact selection can mimic the delta in this two-candidate desk convention.
family_assessments.overlap: C also requires withholding when a discriminating field is incomplete, but B identifies a speaker rather than an instrument's trust. F retains complete identity information. Retain B for attributed testimony and its shared-origin limitation, not for independent-witness disagreement.

family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: assign an operative designation to the right trust using a separate custody reference. Swapping that reference switches the licensed trust endpoint; the partial reference leaves both allocations viable and both endpoints withheld (family_c/review/outputs/comparison.json; family_c/review/agreement.json). Independent excerpt readers verify the three-Source route, and whole-file masks defeat the target while preserving ten ordinary edges (family_c/review/proof-deletions.json). Shared trustees, a wish, an expense and meeting details provide context and a completeness check. Fixed-first, fixed-trust and assign-both rules fail across conditions, but a small pair of parallel settlements and one custody entry bound the inference.
family_assessments.overlap: Shares evidence sufficiency with A and incomplete-reference restraint with B. Its rich invariant graph supports a local completeness check, not a separate distraction or volume finding. Retain the trust-endpoint contrast.

family_assessments.assessment: The approved design varies only the locator of an already-effective amendment. In D0/D1 the earlier survivor changes while the replacement and unaffected trust relationships persist. The saved keys attach joint scope proof to the current beneficiaries, and the closing audit independently verified grouped proof. Separate office provisions and the variation's effective date are context, not distinct tests. Individual fact-level deletion coverage remains incomplete, and reading the locator alone can reproduce the graph. The invariant relationships do not include unrelated kinship. Retain the demonstrated scoped replacement without upgrading the partial deletion audit or altering the admitted keys.
family_assessments.overlap: A isolates effectiveness; D holds it fixed and isolates which provision is displaced. C also uses local references, but D's verified contrast is the survival of an earlier assertion, not a change of trust endpoint.

family_assessments.assessment: The approved design changes one populated working-index label while retaining complete distinguishing identities. F0/F1 preserve the complete named graph and its separately attached proof sets. Withholding an exact identity entry defeats its dependent edge. The original isolated excerpt reader identified the right person in the explanation but entered a different structured surname; the identical-packet independent repeat recovered the correct surname. This is evidence of a bounded label-collision control, not uniformly error-free exact-name extraction. Positional pairing can reproduce the graph. The working index is ancillary; the authoritative reconciliation remains complete.
family_assessments.overlap: B withholds when speaker identity is incomplete; F should not withhold or merge when only an ancillary label collides. Retain this distinction without generalizing to duplicate authoritative identifiers.

gaps.finding: B establishes one origin and its relay, not disagreement between comparable independent origins. E's concordance-to-withholding contrast reproduced technically but was returned over retainer relevance and witness-reference provenance. W is a retained attempt, not admitted evidence. The reserve does not revive either design.

A shows a release-triggered transfer and D a selective amendment already in force. N revision 3 adds technically qualified execution-status coverage, not a formal admission. Collective assent tied to one actual decision and automatic reversion at the express end of a temporary substitution remain distinct gaps. Other amendment mechanisms and complete individual fact-level deletion coverage remain open.

B and C provide local withholding controls, F provides complete-record label invariance, and A alone supplies the verified order-only sibling. These do not diagnose broader collisions, interacting gaps or order sensitivity across genres and workloads.

C preserves ten ordinary edges under a different intervention, and X now supplies a technically qualified incidental-assertion contrast. Neither tests restraint when independently supported graph edges form a tempting but unlicensed kinship inference. Most verified focal proofs are conjunctive; a dedicated check of alternative sufficient routes would distinguish valid proof selection from citation union. No supplied result isolates a placement or volume effect.

T technically qualifies a natural intermediate file about the scope of a completed check; it does not estimate effects of absence, volume or placement. A narrower missing-original/authentication interaction is already contemplated by J. Keep proof masks diagnostic unless separately authorized as an interpretable comparison.

Searching for, requesting, acquiring, OCRing or reconstructing an artifact requires a scope change. A legible supplied note about a record or a missing field can affect what the graph supports, but does not test acquiring that record.

result.portfolio_summary: Five Matter histories are formally admitted: A, B, C, D and F. Matched conditions do not add histories. Joint proof and same-edge attachment recur across all five; identity resolution recurs in B, C and F; instrument authority and scope recur in A and D. The controls are narrower than those labels: A isolates release and presentation order, B isolates speaker attribution, C isolates the deed reference that selects the trust, D isolates the scope of an effective amendment, and F isolates a non-authoritative display collision. None supplies a general estimate of difficulty or extractor performance. X technically qualifies a matched change in firsthand relationship support in native correspondence, T technically qualifies a single intermediate supplied-record custody case with intersecting workstreams, and N revision 3 is newly technically qualified for counterpart execution status. None is counted as formally admitted. E remains diagnostic only after its documentary-realism return. Other retained attempts are not evidence of coverage merely because they were authorized or attempted. Rank the reserve AA, AB, AC, AD: collective authorization with separate assents; a low-cost test of unsupported kinship inference from correctly recovered edges; automatic reversion after a temporary provision; and a natural-file diagnostic of genuinely alternative proof routes. AD has the most uncertain marginal return and should be dropped first if routine retention cannot justify both routes. Ten histories is a planning target, not a quota; the separate 19-history pre-giant technical goal does not turn pending or proposed work into admissions. Intermediate and large workload tiers remain separate commitments. No paid extraction observations or sealed evaluation inputs are available.

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers verify exact passages for eligibility, effect, item identity and each assent, and the exact contrary item reference and receipt scope in the unsupported branch. Check each singleton and plausible shorter subset.

Remove the effect or threshold fact, the proposal-to-item link, and each distinct assent separately; remove any copies of a deleted assent. Rederive each diagnostic key. A forward-only mask should preserve both keys. If a faithful copy is independently sufficient evidence of the first assent, recognize that alternative passage rather than forcing a native citation.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: Only the added beneficiary edge changes. In the supported branch attach the governing rule, exact circulated proposal and both distinct qualifying assents to that edge. In the other branch the supplied record does not establish the required authorization; omit the edge without asserting a negative relationship or a later outcome.
genres_and_provenance: Verified governing extract retained by the trustees: supplies the trust, voter eligibility, effect rule and an independently supported role.
Native two-item circulation kept by the trust secretary: gives the actual decision texts, identifies the named designee and links each text to its routine item reference.
Two native response Sources retained in the designated mailbox, each authored by a different eligible voter and each identifying what that voter approves.
An unchanged working forward of the first assent retained by the secretary or adviser as a progress handoff; its sender supplies no vote of their own.
Dated incoming-response list retained by the secretary: accounts for the responses actually received through the designated channel by the review time, without recording vote content.
Dated adviser brief retained on the advice file: states purpose and cut-off, without a result.
design.intervention: Change exactly one literal item reference in the second native response, from the designation item to the expenditure item. Fix authorship, affirmative wording, all other bytes and Source order.
invariants: Trust, names, electorate, threshold, proposed texts, first assent and its forward, receipt times, cut-off and independently supported roles are fixed.
Expense approval, progress reporting and circulation itself establish no scored relationship.
negative_controls: The working forward contributes no extra assent in either branch. The unaffected trust office keeps its independent proof.
design.scenario: The adviser receives a preliminary governance and accounts pack with two live decisions. The same people respond in both branches. The second eligible assent either completes the designation's threshold or concerns only the other item.
shortcut_heuristics: Test positive-reply counting, duplicate voting, newest reply, item-order matching and proposal-as-decision. A reference token may predict the delta but cannot supply the same-edge proof.
Audit filenames, subject lines, receipt-list wording and quoted text for a leaked tally or another operative route; reorder only in review.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers per branch reconstruct the complete exact-name graph, then fresh excerpt and mask readers confirm the sole delta, the independent voter count and the sufficient proof.
Stop if a conclusive minute would normally already be in the pack, a copy is actually another assent, either reference is unnatural, or the rule requires outside law.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and integration 10–15, blind whole-file and fresh excerpt/mask review 10–15, adjudication and audit 7–11, owner review 2–4. Assumes two isolated readers per branch and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 7 natural Sources. The seven are the governing extract, circulation, two responses, working forward, receipt list and brief. Each must have its own ordinary reason for retention.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse B's origin tracing, C's joint proof and invariant-key checks, and exact-byte sibling verification.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use beneficiary_of and existing invariant trust predicates. Votes, thresholds, expense approvals and unresolved authorization belong in the companion register.
risks_and_limits: A single threshold and workflow do not estimate an authority interaction or establish how real trustees may exercise powers.
If exact matching alone gets the edges right, report that shortcut separately from proof recovery.

assumptions: The fictional terms specify voter eligibility, what constitutes assent, the threshold, when assent counts and that no later countersignature or implementation act is required.
Approving either circulated item is natural; the reply convention exists for real multi-item business, not just to hide the endpoint.
The interim briefing precedes any ordinarily produced decision minute. The dated receipt list establishes the responses received through the stipulated channel, without tallying votes.
grounding.documentary_situation: A circulation covers an additional designation and a separate expenditure item. Individually retained native responses use the circulation's ordinary item references. The governing terms expressly make the designation effective when the required number of distinct eligible trustees assent to that same text through the specified channel.
grounding.legal_workflow: Review written trustee decisions and related accounts business before implementation.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Brief on the approval record at the cut-off, distinguishing an effective designation from approval of routine expenditure.
practitioner_unknowns: Whether a practice and the trustees would naturally retain individually attributable item-specific replies, a receipt list, and a working forward before preparing a consolidated decision record.

references.relevance: Supports retention of decision and expense records. It does not establish voting thresholds, mailbox procedure or the effect of a written response.
references.title: HMRC · Records to keep for trusts

grounding.retainer: Advise the trustees on whether the supplied written responses establish authorization for a proposed named beneficiary designation.

objective.coverage_gap: S fixes decision-maker authority and varies the function of an adopted list; it cannot diagnose whether authority was constituted by independently attributable assent to the same proposition. J links a receipt to an enclosure, not several eligible acts to one collective decision. B traces a shared origin without testing whether miscounting it fabricates authorization.
objective.failure_mechanism: An extractor may count affirmative replies across separate items, count a forward as another voter, or cite only the unconditional wording of the proposed designation.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: Changing what one affirmative response assents to changes support for the named designation only when it changes whether the required distinct eligible voters approved the same item. Correct full keys and sufficient proofs in both branches disconfirm the predicted errors. Reject the design if one response or another act already authorizes the designation.

proposals.title: Separate assents must concern the same decision

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers test each exact sighting and its attribution for singleton sufficiency and the separate explicit sibling passage on its own merits. Audit the entire file for a direct or copied assertion about the focal pair; the parent entries are not a denial of siblinghood.

Delete the edited parent fact and mask its sighting separately; rederive the graph, checking that nothing else proves that parent claim. Mask the explicit sibling statement separately to check its independent route.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The directly supported parent endpoint at the edited sighting changes. The focal sibling edge is absent in both keys and the separately stated sibling edge remains. Report any focal extra edge alongside whether the extractor recovered both parent premises; do not infer a causal mechanism from an extra edge alone.
genres_and_provenance: Two separately dated adviser sighting Sources, retained from full records supplied by their holders for distinct identity checks; each names the subject and the relevant entry.

Two native holder messages, retained as received by the adviser, one for each independently received record, accounting for its supply and the outstanding papers task without repeating the focal parent entry.
A separate native firsthand handover message, retained by the recipient, explicitly identifying an unrelated sibling for an actual papers task.
A dated adviser briefing note, retained on file, fixing scope and cut-off without synthesizing the family graph.
design.intervention: Replace exactly one complete parent-name field in the second sighting with another complete, distinguishable name. Fix the subject, form, date, attribution, surrounding content and all other bytes and order. Do not use a partial field or a change of record type.
invariants: The first sighting, unrelated relationships and proofs, independent explicit sibling statement, receipt paths and cut-off remain fixed.
The focal subjects' identities and the absence of any explicit sibling claim about them are fixed.
negative_controls: The common-parent branch still licenses no focal sibling edge. An explicitly supported sibling relationship elsewhere prevents blanket suppression of that predicate from passing.
design.scenario: The same two record subjects are distinguishable in both branches. One branch has a directly supported parent common to both; the other supports different parents in the corresponding entries. No Source explicitly states a sibling relationship between the focal subjects.
shortcut_heuristics: Test common-parent closure, surname matching, graph union, role-word selection and blanket sibling suppression. Check names, filenames and local proximity for an unintended express link.
A graph with the correct parent names but the other sighting's passage on the affected edge fails proof recovery.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers per branch agree on all exact edges and the focal nonedge; fresh readers verify the direct evidence and bidirectional audit accounts for all kinship cues.
Stop if fixed material makes either parent entry inconsistent, the file implicitly requires adjudicating legal parentage, or the separate sibling statement is present only as a control.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring 6–9, blind whole-file and fresh excerpt/mask review 7–11, adjudication and audit 4–7, owner review 1–3. Assumes two readers per branch and no new scoring rule.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 6 natural Sources. Two sightings, two holder messages, one independent handover message and one briefing note are justified by separate receipt and papers-handling work.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse exact-byte sibling checks, fresh singleton verification and complete-graph scoring. Inspect focal false positives descriptively using the existing edge output.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use directed parent_of and symmetric sibling_of. Common parentage alone is explicitly insufficient under the existing contract. Withholding is omission, not a negative edge.
risks_and_limits: The parent edge changes as well as the shared-parent pattern. This is not an estimate of the isolated effect of motif presence, or a test of all relational inference.

assumptions: Both sightings are equally complete for the focal entry. Each alternative named parent is coherent with all fixed material, and no unseen original is needed to read the finding.
The separate explicit sibling statement is firsthand, has an independent business reason and does not concern the focal pair.
grounding.documentary_situation: Two adult contacts supply separate full records for the identification checks relevant to their own parts of the handover. Dated adviser sightings record the relevant visible entries. Elsewhere a participant explicitly identifies a sibling for a separate, practical papers handover.
grounding.legal_workflow: Reconcile civil-record sightings and contacts' own instructions during an estate papers handover.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Record the relationships supported at the dated review and keep document handling and contact arrangements separate.
practitioner_unknowns: Whether the adviser would retain separate sightings rather than images at this stage and whether both family-record checks and the separate handover message naturally belong in the briefing file.

references.relevance: Distinguishes full birth records containing parentage entries from short records that omit them. It does not establish this retainer, sighting practice or any sibling inference.
references.title: GRO · How to order civil registration records

grounding.retainer: Identify the people explicitly supported by the family papers without determining entitlement or drawing up an inferred genealogy.

objective.coverage_gap: L switches between a visible parent entry and unavailable content; it cannot diagnose an unsupported predication assembled from two affirmative, complete entries. X contrasts firsthand relationship support with logistics, not an inference from already licensed graph edges.
objective.failure_mechanism: An extractor may invent a sibling edge by composing correctly supported parent edges, or avoid that mistake by suppressing directly supported sibling edges.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: A populated parent entry can create or break the shared-parent pattern without licensing any sibling edge for the focal pair. Correct recovery of the direct parent claims, the independently stated sibling claim and the focal nonedge in both branches disconfirms the predicted error.

proposals.title: Supported common parentage does not supply a sibling edge

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers test exact joint excerpts for the affected provision, substitution, duration, resumption and review time. Verify the strongest singleton and short routes, including the base extract by itself in the actual full-file context.

Separately delete the scope link, the expiry fact and the resumption rule, including duplicates. Mask the variation and independently rederive the graph; a mask can restore a base reading rather than simply remove an edge. Document exact evidence excluding the inapplicable branch without emitting a negative predicate.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The continuing branch supports only the substitute within the affected provision; the expired branch supports only the resumed base relationship there. Keep other relationships. Both current focal edges need sufficient passages for the applicable provision, scope, temporal rule and cut-off.
genres_and_provenance: Verified principal instrument extract retained in the trustees' operative papers, recording the base relationship, express authority and a separate unaffected provision.
Executed temporary variation retained with the instrument, identifying the affected provision by local reference and recording the substitute and term.
A trustee minute retained for the forward accounts meeting, commissioning advice before the next payment decision without restating the instrument's dates or current roster.
Prior-period payment reconciliation prepared and retained by the trust accountant, showing what was paid in the earlier accounting period, not conferring status.
Dated adviser brief retained on the advice file, establishing the review cut-off and purpose.
design.intervention: Edit exactly one literal expiry date in the executed variation to a date on the other side of the unchanged cut-off. Both alternatives follow the fixed start and the period covered by the supplied reconciliation; neither equals the cut-off. Hold all other bytes and order fixed.
invariants: Execution, start, authority, provision reference, both people, base and substitute terms, reconciliation and cut-off remain fixed.
An unaffected provision and its proof remain fixed; no payment record becomes operative.
negative_controls: A prior-period payment to the substitute does not establish current status after expiry. The unaffected provision survives both branches and target-only diagnostic deletions.
design.scenario: By the briefing, the temporary provision has indisputably started. It either continues through the cut-off or has ended and the base provision has automatically resumed. The file does not contain a later act restoring the base provision.
shortcut_heuristics: Test latest-instrument, paid-means-current, append-all and wait-for-reappointment rules. Check headings and summaries for leaked status; a date comparison alone cannot establish whose relationship survives.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers per branch agree on the complete graphs, including exclusive support under the affected provision. Fresh readers verify sufficient attachment and the distinct diagnostic effects.
Return if a new act is actually needed for restoration, if either date makes fixed records inconsistent, or if the arrangement needs a legal validity determination.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring 8–13, blind whole-file and fresh excerpt/mask review 9–14, adjudication and audit 6–10, owner review 2–4. Assumes two readers per branch and a separate chronology and scope pass.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 5 natural Sources. Two operative records, one governance minute, one accountant's reconciliation and one dated briefing serve distinct jobs.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Combine A's cut-off checks with D's scope auditing and independently rederived fallback keys.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use beneficiary_of and unchanged trust predicates. Terms, suspension, expiry and payment remain evidence or companion-register context.
risks_and_limits: This tests one express temporary substitution, not implied revival or the validity of a temporary variation under outside law.

assumptions: The base provision is suspended during the defined period, not revoked. The supplied terms expressly establish the permitted substitution, its start and end semantics and its sole scope.
Either expiry date is plausible for the same decision, and nothing in fixed accounts or minutes anticipates a particular end date or independently certifies the current roster.
grounding.documentary_situation: An effective temporary variation substitutes a named provision for a defined term. The principal terms and variation provide for the base provision to resume automatically, with no new designation or receipt. The prior-period payment reconciliation predates both candidate expiry dates.
grounding.legal_workflow: Reconcile operative provisions and prior-period accounts before advice on the next payment decision.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Identify the operative beneficiary provision on the briefing date, separately from the payment ledger.
practitioner_unknowns: Whether this precise temporary arrangement would be recorded and supplied in the proposed form and whether retained payment records would naturally omit a running statement of expiry.

references.relevance: Supports keeping deeds, decisions, minutes and payment records. The duration, suspension and automatic resumption rules must be explicit in the fictional instruments.
references.title: HMRC · Records to keep for trusts

grounding.retainer: Advise on current named trust relationships after a time-limited substitution under express retained terms.

objective.coverage_gap: A diagnoses whether a signed transfer ever took effect; R changes an underlying event date relative to a deadline. Neither diagnoses automatic reinstatement after an admittedly effective temporary override. Q carries forward entries through a new consolidation, whereas this branch difference needs no later operative act at all.
objective.failure_mechanism: Newest-instrument selection may keep an expired substitute; version union may include both; requiring a new affirmative act may omit the reinstated base relationship.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: Changing only the express expiry date across the cut-off flips which of two provisions supplies the current named relationship, even though the substitution became effective in both branches. Correct exclusive rosters and sufficient proofs disconfirm the predicted errors.

proposals.title: A suspended provision resumes without a new act

evidence_dependencies: Fresh isolated readers verify the exact direct passage and the exact two-part historical route, then test each component alone. Delete the bridge separately and show that it defeats only the historical route to the current name, not the direct proof.

Audit every possible repetition and identifier, remove redundant instances of a deleted fact, and independently reconstruct the complete mask keys. Treat lack of support after double removal as neither denial nor evidence of another parent.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The current named edge survives either reciprocal route removal but not the double removal. The eligible sufficient passage sets differ across masks. In the full file either verified complete route passes; no union of the two is required. Independently rederive any historical-name treatment in the bridge diagnostic under the frozen policy.
genres_and_provenance: Verified full civil-record extract retained in the transferred earlier papers and supplied for the review; it contains the relationship under the earlier name.
Dated name reconciliation recorded and retained by the current adviser from checked identity material, with the precise bridge but no parentage statement.
Current signed drafting instructions created by the client, retained as received, recording a firsthand relationship in the course of actual instructions.
An earlier drafting instruction extract retained with transferred papers, relevant to the name discrepancy and outstanding instructions and not restating the focal family claim.
Dated adviser review brief retained on the current file, fixing purpose and cut-off without repeating either proof.
design.intervention: Score the one unchanged natural file. For review only, mask the direct statement, then separately mask the historical parentage passage while leaving the identity bridge; finally remove both relationship assertions and any copies. These are controlled proof diagnostics, not scored siblings.
invariants: The full-file exact-name policy, chronology and any unrelated licensed relationships remain fixed.
Neither an earlier name nor a transfer reference supplies the focal relationship without an assertion.
negative_controls: The name bridge alone, or the historic entry without a current-name bridge, is insufficient for the current named endpoint. The earlier instructions' administrative or testamentary cues confer no scored role.
design.scenario: One natural drafting file contains a direct statement and a documentary route to the same current named family relationship. No artificial matched sibling is needed to examine the difference between necessary passages within a route and alternative routes across the file.
shortcut_heuristics: Test newest-only, official-record-only and cite-everything rules. Check whether headings, current initials, biographical cues or a covering summary create a shortcut past the name bridge.
Do not treat a consistently valid choice of the direct route as model failure or claim to have measured discovery of all available routes.
success_criteria: Two isolated full-file readers agree on the complete exact-name graph. Different readers independently verify both proof routes and the reciprocal and double-removal results.

Stop if the older record is retained only to make the test, the current statement is derivative, the exact-name policy cannot handle a diagnostic without change, or both routes cannot be credited under the existing evidence contract.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring 7–11, blind whole-file and fresh excerpt/mask review 9–14, adjudication and audit 6–10, owner review 2–3. Assumes distinct proof-review readers, two isolated whole-file reads and no scorer change.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 5 natural Sources. A civil extract, identity reconciliation, current instructions, relevant earlier instructions and a dated review brief must each earn retention.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse M's planned name-bridge checks, B's origin tracing, and independently rederived masks. Credit either genuinely sufficient subset under the same-edge contract.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use parent_of with the exact licensed name. A name reconciliation is evidence, not an identity edge. Report proof-route diagnostics separately from the existing graph key.
risks_and_limits: One natural file cannot estimate a causal effect of redundancy, and the scored condition cannot show whether an extractor recognized an alternative it did not cite.

assumptions: The historic material was already retained for a genuine earlier file task and is relevant to the name discrepancy; it is not newly solicited to corroborate a party for the benchmark.

Current signed instructions give a sufficient firsthand statement in their own right, and the identity reconciliation does not repeat the parentage claim. The two routes have no shared missing fact needed to attach the current named edge.
grounding.documentary_situation: A transferred verified civil-record extract identifies a parent under an earlier name. A separate dated identity check reconciles the name discrepancy for the drafting file. The client also refers explicitly to the same child in current signed instructions from personal knowledge, not by summarizing the extract.
grounding.legal_workflow: Reconcile transferred drafting papers and take current written instructions.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Record the client's explicitly supported family relationships for drafting without inferring provisions or entitlement.
practitioner_unknowns: Whether both routes would naturally be available by the same planning meeting and whether the transferred file's retention basis can be shown without extra case-specific paperwork.

references.relevance: Supports the setting of retained instructions and updates, not a requirement to obtain a civil record or the proposed identity reconciliation process.

references.relevance: Supports the distinction between full records carrying parentage and shorter records that omit it.

grounding.retainer: Update will-planning instructions after reconciling an earlier recorded name with the current client identity.

objective.coverage_gap: M tests a necessary bridge without a separate sufficient route for the current named edge. E contemplated multiple affirmative routes sharing a mapping, but was returned and does not establish mixed-arity, independently sufficient routes. B tests copies of one origin, not independent support that legitimately survives reciprocal removals.
objective.failure_mechanism: Graph recovery can be correct while the attached proof is only a name bridge, a historical excerpt without the bridge, or fragments from both routes that complete neither. An audit could also mistakenly require all corroborating Sources on the edge.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: The complete file admits a current named edge through either one direct firsthand passage or the separate civil-record-plus-identity route. One route can be removed without losing that current edge, but removing both defeats it. Complete recovery with either valid attached subset disconfirms the predicted extraction error; if either route relies on the other in isolation, return the design.

proposals.title: One valid route is enough when a second route also exists

stopping_criteria: Authorize construction only after a documentary review explains each Source's creator, distinct business purpose, ordinary retention and availability at the cut-off. Drop a proposal rather than pad it, split a record artificially or withhold a controlling document that would ordinarily be present.

Require two isolated complete full-file reconstructions per scored condition, exact cut-off and name agreement, and adjudication with full rereads after any proof-affecting revision. Section results or stipulated answers cannot substitute for a full-file key.

Verify exact supporting passages and specific limits on competing support in both directions. Accept valid singletons or alternative subsets; attach every necessary member of a joint route to the same edge. Delete needed facts separately, including copies, and rederive each diagnostic graph rather than assuming only deletions.

For matched conditions, reject any comparison with more than one documentary literal changed, altered meaning elsewhere, leaked labels, or an unintended shorter route that defeats the mechanism. Keep review-only masks and permutations out of scored condition counts.

Defer if the existing Person/Trust ontology or exact-name policy cannot represent the result, full-context delivery and review cannot be sustained, or resolution requires outside law, an unseen artifact or a new scoring rule. Do not proceed solely to reach a family or workload target.
